owner: data/calendar / canonical resolved Proper; art-owner intake only
policy: A human score five or Lock approves the artwork aesthetically, not an image file or liturgical placement.
These observed 2026 principal IDs are not certified Proper source paths. Resolve current 1962 Proper before rendering.
Gospel scene has priority only when the actual resolved Gospel matches the exact approved illustrated episode.
Saint/feast imagery is separate from direct Gospel illustration. No season-only substitutions.
Research candidates and contextual-only art must never become automatic primaries.
All old Fra Angelico and El Greco legacy selector holdings are prohibited.
No museum contact, paid licence, unverified exact original or uncertified screenshot asset.
